messages:
Amina K: dropped a tiny mock for a slim filter toolbar inside eval runs: https://figma.com/file/xyz123. It collapses to a pill on narrow widths. feedback on discoverability/a11y? :eyes:
Luis P: quick look 1: love the density. question: keyboard discoverability when collapsed? is there a persistent focus target?
Hannah S: +1. need a focusable toggle with aria-label and visible active count. avoid scroll-triggered collapse.
Amina K: plan: collapse when container width < 720px OR when user toggles compact mode. add persistent pill with aria-label "Open toolbar" and counter. opening moves focus to first control. animation 100ms.
Luis P: ensure Enter/Space opens. move focus programmatically and trap focus while toolbar open.
Hannah S: add aria-live announcement on open/close: "Toolbar collapsed. Press Enter to open." ship small helper snippet in PR.
design-bot: Checklist updated: collapsed-toolbar -> focusable-toggle, aria-live, visible-count, keyboard-open, animation <=200ms. See /docs/accessibility/toolbar-collapse.md :white_check_mark:
Amina K: thanks! I'll update mock and open PR behind flag. Assign: @Luis P write keyboard tests; @Hannah S run SR passes. Target: next sprint.
